sources.title: 2017 Council minutes — WRCOG settlement approval, membership and TUMF
sources.summary: April 4: authorized the Mayor to sign the settlement agreement. May 16: approved the Amended and Restated Settlement Agreement and Release, 4–0, Orozco absent. June 20: approved the WRCOG JPA addendum, 4–0. July 18: approved the membership addendum resolution, 3–0. September 5: adopted the TUMF ordinance and fee schedule resolution, 4–0.
sources.notes: 189-page user-supplied compilation preserved byte-for-byte. Five cited action pages visually reviewed, including vote marks rather than relying on OCR. These findings establish recorded Council actions only; execution, effective dates, dismissal, financial terms, allocations, and receipts require the underlying agreements and other records. Minutes adoption dates not separately established; compilation completeness not assumed.

sources.title: March 7, 2017 agenda — pending WRCOG litigation
sources.summary: The agenda lists WRCOG et al. v. City of Beaumont and related cases, RIC 1211222, G051840, G050794 and 30-2010-0035976, with appeal filed. This verifies the posted listing only, not an outcome or settlement.
sources.notes: 226-page packet; 148 pages have fewer than 100 extractable text characters. Agenda pages 1–2 visually reviewed; attachments require further visual/OCR review. Item 5 concerns a separate Kapanicas claim and is not classified as restitution.

sources.title: 2018 Council minutes — WRCOG and TUMF program context
sources.summary: March 20: approved TUMF improvement and credit/reimbursement agreements with Pardee Homes for the Potrero interchange and Pennsylvania Avenue widening; the Potrero authorization was conditioned on WRCOG approval. September 18: directed research on a proposed TUMF calculation policy. December 18: unanimously approved a WRCOG Joint Powers and Bylaws agreement amendment. These actions do not establish restitution or litigation recoveries.
sources.notes: 199-page compilation; three cited pages visually reviewed. Underlying agreement terms, actual reimbursement payments, and minutes adoption dates not established. Other references remain pending review; no claim of a complete annual archive.
